integrity.numeric_checks: 171 independent finite diagnostic assertions, including a Bessel/ODE cross-check; finite testing does not establish infinite asymptotics.
integrity.proof_basis: Analytic backward equation, exact radial boundary reductions, modified-Bessel large-argument estimates and a local root argument.

scientific_limitations: The high-rotational-diffusion result concerns the quadratic weak-propulsion coefficient, not a joint large-rotation limit at fixed nonzero speed.
Both concentric annular boundaries are perfectly absorbing; translational diffusivity is positive and the initial heading is uniform.
Only the outer-wall local zero is proved to be unique asymptotically. No global zero count is asserted.
No independent scientific audit or publication-priority assessment is claimed.
title: A sharp outer-wall slowdown layer in active-Brownian annular escape
